# `prefer-testing-expect-equal-slices`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports manual slice comparison in a test assertion.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`expectEqualSlices` identifies the mismatching element and preserves
expected/actual context.

## When it fires

It applies when the element type and both slice operands are recognizable.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

test "slices" {
    const a = [_]u32{ 1, 2 };
    const b = [_]u32{ 1, 2 };
    try std.testing.expect(std.mem.eql(u32, &a, &b));
}
```
